summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (loop reference and app thread id) initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in a try/finally inside run_app. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 11 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src (the venv's textual otherwise points at the base checkout). Nothing committed. Existing async tests (test_call_later, test_unmount, test_screens, test_message_pump) fail in this venv because pytest-asyncio is missing, which is unrelated to this change and was not worked around.
